question: The UN General Assembly defined Sustainable Development Goals in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The United Nations General Assembly defined the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in 2015: 
 
 
• Goal 3: Good health and well-being 
 
• Goal 4: Quality education 
 
• Goal 5: Gender equality 
 
• Goal 6: Clean water and sanitation 
 
• Goal 12: Responsible consumption and production 
 
• Goal 14: Life below water 
 
• Goal 15: Life on land 
 
 
 
• The SDGs are part of the UN's 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
 
• The goals are intended to:
 
 
• Eradicate poverty, Find sustainable development solutions, Ensure everyone's human rights, and Make sure no one is left behind by 2030.
